test_elements.description: Values against which to test for each input element

assume_unique.description: If True, assumes both :attr:`elements` and :attr:`test_elements` contain unique elements, which can speed up the calculation. Default: False

invert.description: If True, inverts the boolean return tensor, resulting in True values for elements *not* in :attr:`test_elements`. Default: False

output.description: attr:`elements` that is True for elements in :attr:`test_elements` and False otherwise
